passage:
Divers found an old shipwreck carrying jars, tools, and pieces of wood. The ship itself was broken, but its cargo told a story of trade.
Students learned that shipwrecks are time capsules created by accident. They show what people were moving, what routes they used, and what risks they faced.
The guide also warned that shipwrecks should not be treated as treasure stores. Removing objects without study destroys information.
A student wrote, "The real treasure is context."
The shipwreck lay under water for centuries. When studied carefully, it did not only reveal lost goods. It revealed connections across seas.
